From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap from this morning — traffic shape + pricing guardrails

Jordan — thanks for a productive conversation this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can move to a pricing deep-dive next week. I pasted a short table of what I heard and a few open items below. Attachment: cloudsilk_usage_snapshot.xlsx (uploaded)

High-level summary (please confirm):
- Typical month: ~60M tokens (read: baseline active users)
- Seasonal / peak month (holiday/marketing push): ~240M tokens
- 99th-percentile sustained TPS: ~420 qps
- Short bursts: up to ~1,200 qps for 2–8 minutes (horizontal scaling events)
- Primary use-case: interactive chat + structured output (per-request average ~450 tokens)

Open items I want to lock down for pricing:
1) Floor / ceiling for committed monthly units: is your buying committee comfortable with a 50M–200M tier, or do you expect to commit higher?
2) Peak handling expectation: do you require SLA-backed 99th latency targets at peak bursts, or is best-effort with fallback acceptable?
3) Target $/1M tokens: you mentioned wanting a lane near $15/1M — want to confirm whether $15 is an aspirational internal number or a procurement-floor target.

Preliminary Redwood unit-econ guidance (for reference):
- Uncommitted (pay-as-you-go) hosted API: list ~ $26 / 1M tokens
- Committed tiers (50M+): range $18 — $22 / 1M tokens depending on peak guarantees and term
- Enterprise committed (200M+): $12 — $16 / 1M with SLA and predictable capacity

Suggested next steps:
- You confirm the monthly floor/ceiling and whether the $15/1M figure is hard or aspirational.
- If you want SLA-backed latency at peaks we’ll scope Dedicated capacity options — I can bring Karthik (pricing) on the follow-up.
- Schedule a 45-min pricing deep-dive next Thu or Fri — I’ve tentatively blocked 10am PT Thu.

Thanks — I attached the usage snapshot you shared and our latest pricing card for the follow-up.

Jonas Weber

Thanks Jonas — appreciated the recap. Confirmations and clarifications below (quoted your bullets):

> Typical month: ~60M tokens
That's about right for Q3; Q4 is where things step up.

> Seasonal / peak month: ~240M tokens
We probably under-quoted that — Q4 marketing + new feature launch could push that toward 300M in the highest month (we expect 2–3x baseline on promo days).

> 99th-percentile sustained TPS: ~420 qps / bursts to 1,200 qps
99th sustained is closer to 500 qps for API traffic originating from EU + US. Spikes have hit ~1.5k qps historically (though those were without throttling). We need a plan that handles 1,500 qps bursts for up to 10 minutes.

Budget target: the $15/1M token number is what our finance team used internally as a target when sizing the FY28 budget. Procurement will try to get as close as possible but needs to see committed units + SLA details.

Procurement contact: procurement@cloudsilk.ai (looped) — timeline is internal Q3 procurement review, legal would want T&Cs and a short SOW if we proceed to a committed tier.

Attachment: updated_usage_snapshot.xlsx (I attached an annotated sheet called cloudsilk_usage_snapshot.xlsx)

Happy to lock time for the deep-dive. Thu at 10am PT works for me.

— Jordan
